panel.summary: The fix job checks out the mutable branch while the findings it acts on are attested against head_sha, unlike the review job which deliberately pins the SHA
panel.evidence: agent-review-panel.yml:89-94 pins `ref: workflow_run.head_sha` with an explicit comment that checking out the branch "would review a different commit than the one attested". The fix job at line 386 checks out `ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}` while its findings come from check runs on `head_sha` (line 353-358), so if the branch advanced the agent edits and pushes on top of a tree the panel never saw, with review-attested findings as its only frame. Impact is limited because mark-ready re-evaluates gates against the live `pr.headRefOid` (scripts/agent/mark-ready.mjs:128,146), so it is an attestation/TOCTOU inconsistency rather than a promotion bypass.
panel.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml::the fix job checks out the mutable branch while the findings it acts on are attested against head_sha, unlike the review job which deliberately pins the sha
